test_name: Stun Lock overheat fails in left arm socket - 7f4801fe-00d5-4b1e-a742-b6bf0c6fd7f6
summary: Stun Lock (Addon - Stun Crashers) turns a stun that the item's own arm causes into an overheat of the same length. I set up the reported case in Play mode: Stun Lock on the left arm, then left-arm punches and Focused Blaster blast waves (blaster on the left arm) against a Junkdog and a Jack. Every time one of those hits filled the stun bar, the enemy was stunned and overheated together for the full stun (Junkdog 1.5 s). Jack body hits worked the same way. The only stun without overheat came from an arena floor spike. That is an environment stun, which Stun Lock is not meant to affect. I could not reproduce the bug or find a cause in the code, so I changed nothing.
